proposed_comments.title: Present ordinary Source changes immediately

confidence.rationale: The control only assigns the new source to _hiddenImage in UpdateSource after the first load, and no subsequent call promotes that buffer for ordinary dependency-property updates.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve intrinsic image bounds with double buffering
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve intrinsic image bounds with double buffering

**Severity:** `medium`

The new buffered image control removed the previous `MaxWidth` and `MaxHeight` bindings that were derived from the image's intrinsic size and DPI scale. Because the host enforces a minimum content area, small images can now be enlarged to fill that area instead of staying at native size. Please restore the image previewer's DPI-adjusted maximum size on the buffered control, including the interface/property support needed for the binding.

confidence.rationale: The current XAML replaces the bounded Image with a Stretch-aligned buffered control and the current IImagePreviewer no longer exposes the MaxImageSize value used by the old binding.

proposed_comments.title: Discard stale unsupported-preview UI and icon updates
proposed_comments.body:
### Discard stale unsupported-preview UI and icon updates

**Severity:** `medium`

`RunOnUiThread` and the icon-loading awaits can complete after navigation has canceled and rebound the reusable unsupported-file previewer to a different item. The queued delegate can then restore the old file name/date or `Loaded` state, and the later icon assignment can overwrite the new item's icon. Recheck both cancellation and the current bound item inside delayed UI work and again after asynchronous icon retrieval before mutating the shared preview state.

confidence.rationale: The load path captures currentItem but mutates Preview and State inside delayed UI/asynchronous continuations without a final current-item guard on the current upstream head.
